questions.question: Change 4 750 g into kilograms, as a decimal and as a mixed number.
questions.expected_answer: Divide by 1 000. 4 000 g is 4 kg, and 750 g is three quarters of a kilogram. So 4 750 g is 4,75 kg, or 4 and 3/4 kg.

questions.question: A box holds 12 avocados of 250 g each. What is the mass of the avocados in kilograms?
questions.expected_answer: 12 × 250 g = 3 000 g. Dividing 3 000 g by 1 000 gives 3 kg.

questions.question: The bakkie can carry 500 kg, and each crate is 18 kg. How many full crates can it carry?
questions.expected_answer: 500 divided by 18 is 27 with 14 left over. The bakkie can carry 27 crates, because a 28th crate would take the load over 500 kg.
